budget.label: Royal Mail 2nd class
budget.when: Printed in 1-3 working days, then 2-3 days in the post. Allow 3-6 working days.

first.label: Royal Mail 1st class
first.when: Printed in 1-3 working days, then usually next working day. Allow 2-4 working days.

express.label: Tracked 24 after printing (1-3 days print)
express.when: Printed in 1-3 working days, then a tracked 24-hour courier. Allow 2-4 working days in total. Not same-day dispatch.
